boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named campus spaces for studying, meeting, dining, movement, reflection, and attending events.

cards.title: Quadrangle
cards.subtitle: Central campus green
cards.notes: Bring a book or meet a classmate between commitments; the university identifies the Quad as campus's central shared green space.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor reset point at the center of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Manhattan University describes its 22-acre campus as centered around a large quad that serves as the heart of the community.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; follow university visitor and event guidance.

cards.title: O’Malley Library
cards.subtitle: Map-listed library destination
cards.notes: Use the library as a planned study stop, then check its services and access information before heading over.
cards.short_summary: The campus library anchor for a focused work session.
cards.evidence_claim: The current Manhattan University campus map lists O’Malley Library as a campus building and space.
cards.access_notes: Consult library policies and building access information before visiting.

cards.title: Kelly Commons
cards.subtitle: Student commons and dining hub
cards.notes: Choose a table for a quick meetup or meal break, and use the dining site to confirm the outlets serving that day.
cards.short_summary: A shared indoor hub with dining and gathering spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Manhattan University says Kelly Commons includes dining locations and its campus map lists the Fitness Center, dining, and student resources there.
cards.access_notes: Dining purchases or meal-plan access may be needed for food; check current campus access rules.

cards.title: Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Third floor of the student commons
cards.notes: Plan a workout around the posted schedule and bring an active Manhattan University ID card for entry.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation stop with cardio and strength equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fitness Center is on the third floor of the student commons, and eligible students, faculty, and staff with an active university ID may use it for free.
cards.access_notes: Active Manhattan University ID required; hours are posted by the university.

cards.title: Locke’s Loft Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Campus dining hall
cards.notes: Use the dining page to identify meal-plan options, then make this a sit-down pause between classes or campus events.
cards.short_summary: The university’s named main dining-hall option.
cards.evidence_claim: Manhattan University lists Locke’s Loft Dining Hall among its campus dining locations.
cards.access_notes: Meal plan, Dining Dollars, or other payment may be required; verify current dining hours.

cards.entity_name: Chapel of De La Salle and His Brothers
cards.title: Chapel of De La Salle and His Brothers
cards.subtitle: Squeri Hall chapel
cards.notes: Check the campus calendar for a service, concert, or ceremony, or pause respectfully when the space is open.
cards.short_summary: A named chapel used for campus religious and cultural events.
cards.evidence_claim: Manhattan University identifies its Chapel as a setting for religious services, ceremonies, concerts, and large-scale events.
cards.source_title: Meeting Facilities | Manhattan University Conference Services
cards.access_notes: Availability depends on services, ceremonies, and scheduled events.

cards.title: Draddy Gymnasium
cards.subtitle: Map-listed athletics venue
cards.notes: Look for a scheduled game or campus program, and confirm entry instructions before making it part of your evening plans.
cards.short_summary: A campus gymnasium for athletics and programmed events.
cards.evidence_claim: The current Manhattan University campus map lists Draddy Gymnasium as an athletics destination.
cards.access_notes: Event access and ticketing vary; check the hosting department or athletics schedule.

cards.title: Gaelic Park
cards.subtitle: Map-listed athletics venue
cards.notes: Check the athletics or events schedule, then attend a listed game or program with friends using the posted visitor guidance.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor athletic destination connected to campus life.
cards.evidence_claim: The current Manhattan University campus map lists Gaelic Park as an athletics destination.
cards.access_notes: Access depends on scheduled athletic events and venue policies.

cards.title: Multifaith Prayer Space
cards.subtitle: Kelly Commons
cards.notes: Use this named space for a quiet, respectful pause; check campus guidance if you need current access or program details.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed campus space for reflection and prayer.
cards.evidence_claim: The current Manhattan University campus map lists a Multifaith Prayer Space in Kelly Commons.
cards.access_notes: Respectful use expected; verify building access and any scheduled programming.

cards.title: McNeil Courtyard
cards.subtitle: Map-listed courtyard
cards.notes: Use this named courtyard as an outdoor meeting point or a short break while moving between nearby campus buildings.
cards.short_summary: A named courtyard for an open-air pause on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The current Manhattan University campus map lists McNeil Courtyard as a campus building and space.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus area; follow posted university access and event guidance.
